Setup.Name: Simple text payload
Setup.Description: Parses a simple text payload as an integer signal.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Processor Temperature"
    Description: "Reads raw payload data."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/raw"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "Processor.Temperature"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          Instrument: Gauge
          Attributes:
            - Key: "test"
              Value: "value"
          Value: "PAYLOAD()"
